accepted_material.provenance_policy: A25-A27 accepted material carried without reruns. Original XML/UPF bytes hashed here. Large background archive, density and WFC not decoded here; existing bound loader verifies original bytes when Root executes.

scope: New differentiated ordinary NC UPF operator and selected-column full-PW consumer; accepted A25 and original current modules untouched.
construction: Exact spherical Bessel transforms on the original QE Simpson radial quadrature; regular Cartesian solid harmonics; analytic first and mixed second derivatives. Reference is the discretized physical UPF quadrature, not the saved forward cubic interpolant. C2 quintic Hermite in s=|p|^2 offers explicitly refined representation.
preserved_H0: H_anchor(a)=H_A25(0)+H_UPF(a)-H_UPF(0), with only nonlocal and kinetic field differences. The constant nonlocal correction is explicitly a reference approximation, never shift fitted or claimed equal to Peierls dressing of saved H0.

primary_blocks.beta_mod.f90:100-116,149-163,195-209: Original radial quadrature and forward cubic value/derivative. interp_dbeta differentiates local cubic, not a separately smooth derivative table.
primary_blocks.commutator_Hx_psi.f90:77-81,110-129,185-: Kinetic sign, radial/angular legs and both nonlocal legs
primary_blocks.compute_ppsi.f90:55-60: Ry derivative L gives atomic velocity L/2 and electronic charge current -L/2
primary_blocks.sph_bes.f90:40-56,81-113: Origin and truncated small-x Bessel approximation replaced by analytic Bessel function evaluation

adverse_evidence.conclusion: Not converged. Existing calculation is not repeated. Non-C1 table knots and nonzero interpolated origin slopes can obstruct a Hessian; new consumer reports actual origin slopes and knot diagnostics without claiming sole numerical cause.

API.UPFRadial.evaluate(s): Original radial Simpson sum with exact Bessel function, returns F,F_s,F_ss for regular B_lm=(-i)^l S_lm F_l(s).
API.HermiteRadial(exact,qmax,spacing): C2 quintic representation in s=q^2 matching exact F,F_s,F_ss at uniform-q nodes. No extrapolation; explicit representation refinement.
API.centered_derivatives(radial,p,left,right: B,B_left,B_right,B_left,right including origin and angular/radial cross terms.
API.MaterialFieldDerivatives.derivative_acti: Full-row analytic L_left and C_left,right actions. All four nonlocal mixed-contact legs and full active D retained.
API.MaterialFieldDerivatives.field_action(ve: Anchored preserved-A25 reference, or physical UPF family when anchored=False.
API.MaterialFieldDerivatives.nonlocal_delta_: Direct action difference against original A25 nonlocal operator, without large local-field subtraction.
API.run_material_field_derivatives.consume: Existing MaterialHamiltonian plus 1..8 full-row columns, explicit direction/mixed_direction/step_bohr_inv/spacing_bohr_inv; returns raw arrays and measured comparison summary.

derivative_equations.regular_radial: F_l^(n)(s)=4pi/sqrt(Omega) sum_r w_r r beta_r (-1/2)^n r^(l+2n) j_(l+n)(r sqrt(s))/(r sqrt(s))^(l+n), n=0,1,2.
derivative_equations.origin: j_m(x)/x^m -> 1/(2m+1)!!. Cartesian solid harmonics are polynomials; p-channel first derivatives and s/d-channel second derivatives are generally nonzero at p=0.
derivative_equations.mixed_contact: C_ef=2(e.f)I+B_ef D B†+B_e D B_f†+B_f D B_e†+B D B_ef†.
derivative_equations.phase: Fixed exp(-ip.tau) placement; omitted uniform exp(-ia.tau) cancels exactly within each atom BDB†.
derivative_equations.units_and_sign: L in Ry bohr, C in Ry bohr^2; energy H+aL+a^2C/2; electronic charge current -L/2 in atomic units.

oracle_scope: Independent SymPy chain/product rules and cubic-knot/origin obstruction; literal finite radial Simpson sum plus spherical angular quadrature differentiating exp(-irp.n); dense finite-H comparison; C2 representation refinement; exposing omitted right leg, mixed projector legs, angular leg, radial/angular cross terms, offdiagonal D, reversed current sign and zero-origin mutations.
command_qualification: Directions and numeric h,dq are explicitly numerical probe coordinates, not prescribed physical field geometry or accepted converged values. Compare dq=.04,.02,.01 against direct radial quadrature and h=.004,.002,.001 only for the new C2 family; no old cubic-contact rerun.
diagnosis_scope: QE interp_dbeta is the derivative of each forward cubic interval, not a smooth radial derivative generator. Even q^4 sampled at q=0,1,2,3 yields an interpolant with origin slope 6 and a first-derivative jump 8 at q=1. Composition with |p| thus can create a cusp absent from the physical UPF transform. Material consumer measures actual table slopes and jumps; exclusive attribution of the prior growing errors is not claimed.
change_log: Added a usable analytic UPF field family, explicit anchored reference, origin-regular current/contact, C2 representation refinement and full-row consumer; no accepted source changed.
limitations: Finite original radial mesh/quadrature is retained; continuum radial discretization error cannot be certified by reciprocal representation refinement.
No new DFT, geometry, temperature, linewidth, field amplitude, or occupation introduced.
No numerical oracle or material consumer executed by worker.
